LanguageData.RimTalk.DisplayOptimization.AdvancedGuid:
This mod adds {{ soul_rules }} to RimTalk's original Dialogue Prompt by default, and adds {{ text_rules }} to Json format, ##If you change the names of the two entries above, or use your own custom entries, the mod's functionality will cease to work
If you wish to continue using this mod's preset prompts, you can manually add {{ soul_rules }} and {{ text_rules }} in the appropriate places within your own entries
Below is the impact of mod options on the preset prompts {{ soul_rules }}:If "Enable Inner Voice Mode" is unchecked, or "Color Only Mode" is enabled, {{ soul_rules }} will no longer be added to RimTalk's original Dialogue Prompt entry, and previously added ones will be deleted. No prompts regarding inner thoughts will be sent to the AI, but {{ soul_rules }} manually added by you in other entries will remain valid Preset prompt content: [Cognitive Wall]: Pawns cannot perceive Inner Monologue in {s.SymThoughtL}{s.SymThoughtR}. Their actions, dialogue, and attitudes must be based solely on actions in {s.SymActionL}{s.SymActionR} and spoken dialogue, and they must accept these surface interactions as truth.
[State Separation]: Pawns must maintain “/State Separation”/—even if talking within {s.SymThoughtL} {s.SymThoughtR} to the Soul-Reader, their public persona and actions towards other pawns must remain perfectly in-character. If a Soul-Reader blurs a secret publicly, pawns must act shocked, confused, or defensive. (This section triggers only when a "Soul Reader" is present in the dialogue or the player speaks proactively, and is sent for the number of turns defined in mod settings after triggering) ## The User watches from shadows. You MUST show Inner Monologue in {s.SymThoughtL}{s.SymThoughtR} in every dialogue for him. ##
{{ text_rules }}:Added to the Json format entry by default, but its content will be affected by this mod's setting options Preset prompt content: ""text"": - Wrap the Action in {s.SymActionL} {s.SymActionR}. (turn off 'action coloring', this message will be deleted) ... - Wrap the Inner Monologue in {s.SymThoughtL} {s.SymThoughtR} (This line will be removed if the Inner Voice System is disabled in settings) - Wrap every mention of a person (name, nickname or title) in single Pipe. like |name| (Sent periodically based on settings; this line will be removed if 'Name Highlighting' is disabled in settings) - Wrap core keywords and emotional emphasis in double asterisks. like **hate** ,but each sentence must not exceed three pairs (Sent periodically based on settings; this line will be removed if 'Emphasis Highlighting' is disabled in settings) (The content above will be sent continuously for the first 3 turns after loading the game)
Turn counter variable: rt_total:Starts from 0, records the current dialogue turn count, outputs a number Usage: {{ if (rt_total < 3) || (rt_total % 2 == 0) }} Content or logic {{ end }} (Achieves sending content for the first three turns upon loading, then sending content once every two turns)
{{ if rt_total % 4 == 0 }} Content 1 {{ end }} {{ if rt_total % 4 == 1 }} Content 2 {{ end }} {{ if rt_total % 4 == 2 }} Content 3 {{ end }} {{ if rt_total % 4 == 3 }} Content 4 {{ end }} (This can implement things like rotating vocabulary injection to reduce token consumption) (Actually, these could probably be implemented directly via code, but this way should be more convenient, right?)
